messages:
maria.peopleops: Hey everyone — starting this live thread for today's All-Hands People Ops Q&A. Drop short questions about performance reviews, leveling, promotions, comp, benefits. We'll answer live and post follow-ups.
alex.s: Quick one: will mid-year calibration change band ranges? my ICs are asking.
maria.peopleops: Short answer: not this cycle. We're keeping bands stable; any changes would be announced earlier. Full notes coming after calibration meeting.
jordan_eng: For promotions — does the usual manager+skip-level sign-off still apply? or are we adjusting for remote orgs?
emily_hr: still manager + skip-level + calibration panel. We're piloting asynchronous evidence collection to speed things up.
sam_cto: adding — Promotions aren't paused. If your team is affected by hiring freeze, we might delay ramping new roles, but promotions are evaluated on merit.
natalie_recruiting: For raises related to external offer matches, are we still doing counteroffers + 1:1 comp reviews?
maria.peopleops: We still do comp conversations. If you have a documented offer, escalate to people-ops@redwood and include comp packet. Expect review within 5 business days.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: self-review deadline is 2026-04-15. Submit via:
```
/goals submit --user $USER --cycle 2026Q2
```
alex.s: thx — also any update on equity refresh cadence? been a common ask.
emily_hr: Equity refreshes are handled case-by-case; we plan to publish a refresh rubric by end of month.
jordan_eng: Can ICs request leveling re-evaluation outside of cycle? like immediate re-level if scope expanded?
maria.peopleops: Yes — managers can submit an out-of-cycle leveling packet with evidence. Use the template linked below: https://intra.redwood/careers/leveling-template
sam_cto: we'll also publish a FAQ after the all-hands with examples of accepted evidence (impact, scope, leadership). Expect that in ~48 hrs.
alex.s: will the new comp bands be retroactive to reviews done before announcement?
maria.peopleops: No — changes apply to post-announcement cycles unless stated otherwise.
emily_hr: Benefits quick Q: any change to parental leave policy this year?
maria.peopleops: No changes planned for now. We are researching expanded fertility benefits — updates in next benefits survey.
jordan_eng: thanks — can we get a short timeline recap in this thread after AH so managers can communicate to teams?
maria.peopleops: Absolutely. I'll post a TL;DR with dates, owners, and links after the session. :sparkles: 
people-ops-bot: Follow-up: calibration panel scheduled 2026-04-20 10:00 PT. RSVP link: https://calendar.redwood/xyz
sam_cto: if anyone has a sensitive case, DM me or @maria.peopleops; we'll handle privately.
maria.peopleops: thanks everyone — keep questions coming below. we'll close the thread and transfer key FAQs to the handbook.
